body_html:
#smallpoems
#edu522

Hardest notes
   sought in tonal
caskets collapsing
on off beat rackets
while simple counts
  escape
me
beckoning on a
reckoning of a
four four
perused
around a
score
gathered
on patterns

I can not see
on the
ONE
or Glory
  of the TWO
    FOUR.
   Hardest music at
it's core,
is rhythm of
silence and
patience
